description: This file contains utility functions for handling HTTP and file download operations using libcurl, including initializing and destroying curl resources, performing GET and PUT requests, downloading files to memory or disk, and handling authentication via mTLS or tokens.

methods.name: void * doCurlInit(void)
methods.description: Initializes curl resources and returns the curl handle.

methods.name: void doStopDownload(void * curl)
methods.description: Releases curl resources associated with the provided curl handle.

methods.name: int doInteruptDwnl(void * in_curl,unsigned int max_dwnl_speed)
methods.description: Pauses and resumes a download, optionally throttling speed.

methods.name: unsigned int doGetDwnlBytes(void * in_curl)
methods.description: Retrieves the number of bytes downloaded in a curl session.

methods.name: int doCurlPutRequest(void * in_curl,FileDwnl_t * pfile_dwnl,char * jsonrpc_auth_token,int * out_httpCode)
methods.description: Performs a curl PUT request with optional headers and token.

methods.name: int getJsonRpcData(void * in_curl,FileDwnl_t * pfile_dwnl,char * jsonrpc_auth_token,int * out_httpCode)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP download with JSON-RPC token authentication.

methods.name: int doHttpFileDownload(void * in_curl,FileDwnl_t * pfile_dwnl,MtlsAuth_t * auth,unsigned int max_dwnl_speed,char * dnl_start_pos,int * out_httpCode)
methods.description: Downloads a file over HTTP with optional mTLS and speed throttling.

methods.name: int doAuthHttpFileDownload(void * in_curl,FileDwnl_t * pfile_dwnl,int * out_httpCode)
methods.description: Downloads a file with authentication, such as certificates.
